## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `eebb750068c5d5a22372f46ee678f400be42da97`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the full diff `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main pr36655) pr36655` (17 files: `.changeset/36227-sidebar-resize-float-card.md`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/SidebarWidthHandle.tsx`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `consoleSidebarRail.ts`, `__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.hiddenCollapse-35062.test.tsx`, `__tests__/consoleSidebarRail.width-27593.test.tsx`, the 11 `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`) + cited at head: `ui/packages/app-shell/package.json`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/index.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference.ts`, `ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx` (lines 236-290), `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx` (the sibling handle), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/FavoritesProvider.tsx` (user-scoped keys, for comparison), `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` (header), `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` (line regexes), `AGENTS.md` lines 1018-1040; PR #36655 body; cards #36227 and #36471 with their comments; head check runs (REST)

### ① Derived judgments

- Published surface is the one i18n key. `sidebar.resize` is added under `sidebar` in all 11 locale files (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant). Each is a real translation, none is English copied over.
- No new public export. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `"private": true`, and its only exports entry is `.` -> `dist/index.js`. Neither `src/index.ts` nor `src/layout/index.ts` re-exports `consoleSidebarRail.ts` or `SidebarWidthHandle.tsx`. The new constants (`CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_MIN_WIDTH`, `CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_MAX_WIDTH`, `clampConsoleSidebarWidth`, `CONSOLE_SIDEBAR_WIDTH_PREFERENCE`, `RAIL_HIDDEN_PANEL`, `SIDEBAR_RESIZING_FRAME`, `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_KEY_STEP`) and the `SidebarWidthHandle` component are module exports inside the package only. `@object-ui/components` is untouched.
- Declarations hold. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right for an added i18n key. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: no spec, schema or authorable key moves. The width is a reader preference in `localStorage`, not metadata.
- Note: the changeset's Clause-② gloss says the widening also includes "new exports from the app shell's sidebar module (the width range, its kept preference and the float's classes)". That contradicts the PR body and the claim amendment ("no spec, schema or published export change"), and it is not true of the published surface. It over-claims and changes nothing, but the text lands in the i18n CHANGELOG. Trim it to the one key.

### ② Semver level

- Both moved packages (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`) have a `patch` entry. `Metadata-protocol: none` requires `patch` on every entry under the level axis of `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`. No `major`. No `authorable-surface/` or `authorable-defaults/` baseline moves.
- Both declaration lines start at the beginning of a line in the PR body and in the changeset body. `clause2-line.mjs` reads the arm as a prefix, so the trailing gloss does not affect parsing. `Check Changeset` is green at head (2 of 2 runs).
- Level: correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Width store, per browser. The key is `os:pref:console.sidebar.width` (workspace preference, scope `user`, which means "this reader, across objects". It is not keyed by user id). Two people on one shared browser share the width. Favorites, recents and last-app use `scopedKey(..., userId, orgId)` because they hold user data. A pixel width is not sensitive, and the sibling `console.sidebar.keepOpen` and record-details width use the same unscoped store. Card #36227 asks for "记在浏览器里" (kept in the browser). Note only.
- Clamping on read. The codec's `fromRecord` takes only a finite number and clamps it to 200..350. Anything else answers "no choice", which falls back to 256. A newer `v` or a malformed record also answers "no choice" (the module's contract). The test pins 9000 -> 350. Note: there is no test for a below-range value or a non-number value. The code covers both.
- Below 768 px. `docked` needs `desktop`, and the frame's `--sidebar-width` style is set only when `rail.desktop`. The phone drawer keeps `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE`. A test pins 700 px: no handle and no width. No other consumer reads `--sidebar-width` outside the frame. Note: at 768 px a 350 px sidebar leaves 418 px for content, and the 1280 px rail threshold in `consoleSidebarRail.width-27593` is costed at 256. A reader who widens the sidebar pays up to 94 px more. This is the reader's own choice, and screenshot 8 shows the preview is unaffected.
- Keyboard a11y. The handle has `role="separator"`, `aria-orientation="vertical"`, a translated `aria-label`, `aria-valuenow`/`min`/`max`, and `tabIndex=0`. Left and right arrows move it 16 px, Home and End go to the ends, and the focus-visible ring is drawn on the inner bar. Tests pin all keys and the ARIA values. Note: no `aria-controls`. This is optional, and the sibling `RecordPageColumns` handle omits it too.
- #36471 fix. A press in the float clears `closeTimer`. When the timer fires, it folds only if no menu or dialog is shown and the last away point is not now on the panel. Stuck-open check: when the fire-time check bails, it leaves `closeTimer` undefined. The next pointer move off the float restarts the clock, and a press outside, Esc, a navigation and Ctrl/Cmd+B still close or dock it. So the float stays open after a menu closes only until the next move, which is what the card asks for ("菜单关闭后再按平时的规则收回"). Test "once the menu closes, moving away folds the float as before" pins this. `layerShown()` is document-wide, so any open dialog anywhere holds the float. That was already true on the move path before this PR. The PR adds the same check at fire time, so it adds no new kind of hold. `pointerOnFloat` reads the panel's live box and allows the card's 8 px margin, which matches the card geometry.
- Cleanup. Both `closeTimer` clears are in the effect cleanup, and the unmount effect still clears both timers. The handle adds no document listeners. Note: `SidebarWidthHandle` writes `cursor` and `user-select` on `document.body` and has no unmount cleanup. `UnifiedSidebar` never resets `dragWidth` when the handle goes away. If the handle unmounts mid-drag (Ctrl/Cmd+B pressed while the edge is held, or the window crossing 768 px mid-drag), `body` keeps `user-select: none`, the width stays at the drag value and the frame keeps `transition-none` until the next drag ends or the page reloads. The fix is small: a `useEffect` cleanup that calls `end(false)` when `drag.current` is set. Classed as a note, not should-fix, because a user only reaches it by unmounting the handle while holding a drag.
- Tests. `consoleSidebarRail.width-27593.test.tsx` changes only a doc comment ("fixed at 256" becomes "default 256; the reader may drag it"). No assertion changed, and the 256 equality with the primitive is still pinned. This is justified. In `UnifiedSidebar.hiddenCollapse-35062.test.tsx` the changes are import additions plus 9 new tests, with no existing test edited. `UnifiedSidebar.railOverlay-27593.test.tsx` still asserts every `RAIL_OVERLAY_PANEL` token on the panel, and the token set got larger. No test is weakened. CI at head: Type Check, Lint, Check Changeset, Build & E2E UI and Live E2E UI are green. Test UI shards 3, 8 and 10 are green, and the other shards were still running when read.

### ④ Design judgment

- #36227 item 1 (drag 200..350, double-click back to 256, kept and reloaded): implemented and pinned. The numbers match the card. The default stays 256, not Attio's 275, as the card says.
- Items 2 and 4 (card float, kept width): the float is 8 px off the left, top and bottom edges, with `rounded-lg`, a border and `shadow-xl`. There is no backdrop and the gap stays 0, so nothing is dimmed or moved. The float takes `--sidebar-width` from the frame. The hidden panel is parked by its width plus 2 rem, so the shadow does not show at the edge. Item 3 (hover floats it, moving away folds it, the button docks it) was already on main and is unchanged. Note: the panel's translucent `bg-sidebar` with blur is pre-existing and differs from Attio's opaque card. The PR says this openly, and it is out of the card's scope.
- The float has no handle. This is a reasonable reading: the card asks for resizing only while docked.
- #36471: the root cause is stated (the away clock started while the float was sliding in, and nothing checked it at fire time) and fixed at both halves. The PR body says an ablation pins each half. Item 2 (account menu, an entry's `…`) has browser screenshots. The notification panel is not shown, but it uses the same press path and the same layer check (a popover is `role="dialog"`). Note.
- The shape follows the sibling `RecordPageColumns` handle (preview during a drag, commit when it ends). It is small and local, and it does not change `@object-ui/components`.

Open must-fix: none. Open should-fix: none. Notes: the changeset gloss over-claims the surface (①); no handle cleanup on unmount mid-drag (③); the width is per browser, not per user (③); no below-range or non-number read test (③); the 768 px and 1280 px cost at 350 (③); no `aria-controls` (③); translucent card and notification panel not shown (④).
